strengths: Distinct light climber body with four limbs and one long balancing tail; no separate wing pair.
Front/rear, opposing profiles, top, three-quarter, underside and folded/spread studies present.
Berries and cliff-grip pose give readable ecology.
Organic tan/ivory/rust feather and membrane surfaces avoid literal mechanical bamboo construction.
v01_issues: Skeleton labels duplicate/misplace indices (e.g. 1 at shoulder/spine and 8 by hand); numbered articulation map is not usable as rig instructions.
Grasp detail labels say four digits; oblique hand/foot arrangement is not consistently countable across all small views.
Spread wrist-to-ankle membrane depicted, but folded state loses clear attachment path and feathers obscure continuity.
Long feathered ear silhouette and birdlike beaked skull are extra generated interpretations, not source-established anatomy.
Head, back and tail feathers extend beyond requested edge-only feather fringe; medium reads more detailed painterly than strict large faceted low-poly.
remaining_blockers: Digit and membrane attachment continuity require targeted review/correction before modeling.
Skeleton labels need correction and skull/ear interpretation approval.
